assertion_results.text: The plan determines feature-branch workflow mode (not direct-to-main) based on the atomicity constraints in the feature description
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md contains '## Workflow Mode Decision' with 'Selected mode: feature-branch' and lists 3 atomicity indicators: (1) Coordinated schema migrations — enum type + column + table drop, (2) Breaking API changes — code depends on migration and vice versa, (3) Tightly coupled feature components — entity definitions, service layer, endpoints, and ingestion all depend on schema change. summary-comment.md also states 'Mode: feature-branch'.

assertion_results.text: A bookend task with Bookend Type create-branch is generated as the first task in the plan
assertion_results.evidence: task-1-create-feature-branch.md contains '## Bookend Type\ncreate-branch' and is the first task (task-1) in the plan. Description says 'Create and push the feature branch TC-9005 from the latest main.'

assertion_results.text: A bookend task with Bookend Type merge-branch is generated as the last task in the plan
assertion_results.evidence: task-7-merge-feature-branch.md contains '## Bookend Type\nmerge-branch' and is the last task (task-7) in the plan. Description says 'Create a PR to merge feature branch TC-9005 into main.' No task-8 or higher exists.

assertion_results.text: All intermediate tasks (between the create-branch and merge-branch bookend tasks) have Target Branch set to TC-9005
assertion_results.evidence: All 5 intermediate tasks have Target Branch set to TC-9005: task-2-migration-enum-column.md line 5 'TC-9005', task-3-update-entity-definitions.md line 5 'TC-9005', task-4-update-advisory-service-endpoints.md line 5 'TC-9005', task-5-update-ingestion-pipeline.md line 5 'TC-9005', task-6-update-integration-tests.md line 5 'TC-9005'.

assertion_results.text: The create-branch bookend task has Target Branch set to main
The merge-branch bookend task has Target Branch set to main

assertion_results.evidence: All 5 intermediate tasks list Task 1 (create-branch) as a dependency: task-2 '- Depends on: Task 1 — Create feature branch TC-9005 from main', task-3 '- Depends on: Task 1 — Create feature branch TC-9005 from main', task-4 '- Depends on: Task 1 — Create feature branch TC-9005 from main', task-5 '- Depends on: Task 1 — Create feature branch TC-9005 from main', task-6 '- Depends on: Task 1 — Create feature branch TC-9005 from main'. assertion_results.text: The merge-branch bookend task lists all non-documentation intermediate tasks as dependencies
assertion_results.evidence: task-7-merge-feature-branch.md Dependencies section lists all 5 intermediate tasks: 'Depends on: Task 2 — Database migration for enum column', 'Depends on: Task 3 — Update entity definitions', 'Depends on: Task 4 — Update advisory service and endpoints', 'Depends on: Task 5 — Update ingestion pipeline', 'Depends on: Task 6 — Update integration tests'.

assertion_results.text: Each non-documentation task file contains all required template sections: Repository, Target Branch, Description, at least one of Files to Modify or Files to Create, Implementation Notes, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements. Documentation tasks are exempt from requiring Files to Modify, Files to Create, and Implementation Notes — they must still include Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements
assertion_results.evidence: Intermediate implementation tasks 2-6 all contain required sections (Repository, Target Branch, Description, Files to Modify/Create, Implementation Notes, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements). However, bookend tasks (task-1-create-feature-branch.md and task-7-merge-feature-branch.md) are non-documentation tasks that lack 'Files to Modify', 'Files to Create', and 'Implementation Notes' sections. The assertion exempts only documentation tasks; bookend tasks are not exempted in the assertion text. Bookend tasks do contain Repository, Target Branch, Bookend Type, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements, and Dependencies — they intentionally omit Files to Modify/Create and Implementation Notes per the plan-feature SKILL.md design, but the assertion does not account for this exemption.

assertion_results.text: Convention-aware enrichment validates file-type applicability per shared/convention-applicability-rules.md before including a convention — inapplicable conventions are excluded entirely (not listed with 'Not applicable' annotations), and applicable ones include a rationale in the prescribed format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>'), not free-form prose
assertion_results.evidence: All convention references across tasks 2-6 use the prescribed 'Applies:' format: task-2 'Applies: task creates migration/src/m0002_advisory_status_enum/mod.rs matching the convention's migration file scope', task-3 'Applies: task modifies entity/src/advisory.rs matching the convention's Rust/SeaORM scope', task-4 'Applies: task modifies modules/fundamental/src/advisory/service/advisory.rs matching the convention's Rust handler scope', task-5 'Applies: task modifies modules/ingestor/src/graph/advisory/mod.rs matching the convention's Rust module scope', task-6 'Applies: task modifies tests/api/advisory.rs matching the convention's Rust test file scope'. assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9005 has Priority: High (not 'Undefined'). impact-map.md: 'Priority: High (inherited from Feature TC-9005 — will be propagated to all created tasks)'. summary-comment.md: 'Priority: High — inherited from Feature TC-9005 and propagated to all created tasks via additional_fields: { "priority": {"name": "High"} }'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9005 has Fix Versions: RHTPA 2.0.0 (non-empty). No ### Jira Field Defaults section in CLAUDE.md, so fixVersion scope defaults to 'both'. impact-map.md: 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 2.0.0 (inherited from Feature TC-9005 — fixVersion scope defaults to "both" since no ### Jira Field Defaults section is configured, so fixVersions are propagated to tasks)'. summary-comment.md: 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 2.0.0 — inherited from Feature TC-9005 and propagated to all created tasks... The fixVersion scope configuration defaults to "both" (no ### Jira Field Defaults section is present in CLAUDE.md), so fixVersions are propagated to tasks.'

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists in the outputs directory and contains '## Inherited Field Propagation' section documenting: Priority 'High' inherited and propagated, Fix Versions 'RHTPA 2.0.0' inherited and propagated with fixVersion scope defaulting to 'both', and Labels 'ai-generated-jira' applied. impact-map.md also has '## Inherited Field Values' section with the same information.
